remarks: Welcome to 35 St. Mays, a beautifully upgraded carriage-style Ladera Ranch townhome offering 1,498 square feet, 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, plus a private patio-balcony and Newer HVAC! Home upgrades include a newer HVAC system with overflow safety shutoff and upgraded Lennox Healthy Climate MERV 16 Filtration, newer water heater, Nest thermostat, whole-house water softener and filtration system, Cat-5 Ethernet wiring throughout, added exhaust fan in the primary bath, and washer, dryer, & refrigerator are included. Perfectly situated in one of Ladera Ranch's most vibrant neighborhoods, this home is surrounded by parks, pools, playgrounds, clubhouses, sports courts, walking trails, Halloween trick or treating galore, and a true sense of community where neighbors gather and children play. Enjoy an easy walk to award-winning schools and multiple parks and pools including: Poet’s Park, Cherry Plunge Park, Terramor Aquatic Park, Ladera Skate Park, Oso Grande Elementary, Ladera Middle, Avendale Clubhouse, Public Library, and Founders Park - home to the weekly Farmers Market and annual Fourth of July Festival and Fireworks.

remarks: From the street, this Arlington Heights Craftsman looks like it's held a hundred years of stories, and it has. But behind that classic facade is a home the owner has taken all the way down to the studs and reimagined for the way we live today. Converted and permitted from a three-bedroom into a spacious four-bedroom, four and a half bath, it delivers something rare: the warmth and character of an original Craftsman paired with the layout, systems, and finishes of true new construction. Inside, high ceilings and an open, light-filled floor plan set the tone, while top-notch finishes and thoughtfully considered details carry through every room. There isn't a corner of this home that hasn't been reconsidered and elevated. A full garage and an unusually large lot gives you room that most homes in this pocket simply can't offer, and the 3-rd level attic space presents even more potential, ready to be finished and open for discussion with the right buyer. This home  is for someone who wants to live in one of Los Angeles' most stunning homes while being in a vibrant and centrally located neighborhood.

Must see to appreciate.

remarks: A grand sense of arrival sets the tone for this spacious residence in Villa Seville, ideally situated in San Pedro's desirable Vista Del Oro neighborhood. Offering 1,852 square feet, the building's largest floorplan, this expansive single-level home provides a two-bedroom, three-bath residence with flexible potential for a third bedroom. Just off the main living area, a versatile bonus space already features a walk-in closet, three-quarter bath, sliding door to the balcony, and captivating harbor view, ideal as an office, den, guest retreat, or future third bedroom by adding a partial wall. From the formal entry, the sprawling living spaces unfold toward sweeping views of the Palos Verdes hills, Vincent Thomas Bridge, and LA Harbor. The generous living room centers around a fireplace and opens through sliding glass doors to an oversized balcony, extending the living space outdoors for morning coffee, coastal breezes, and a panorama that transforms after dark as the harbor and bridge lights begin to glow. A walk-in wet bar connects to the entertaining areas, while the dining room opens across a bar top to the well-equipped kitchen. Abundant white cabinetry, neutral countertops, a stainless steel five-burner gas range, dishwasher, refrigerator, built-in microwave, trash compactor, and generous casual dining nook support everyday living and hosting. Down the hall, a coat closet and built-in linen storage lead to a full guest bath with tile flooring and tub/shower enclosure, and a spacious secondary bedroom with built-in desk and walk-in closet. The generous and private primary suite offers two closets, a ceiling fan, and a dedicated bath with separate spa tub plus privacy doors to the restroom and shower. Even the in-home laundry room enjoys a Palos Verdes hillside view and includes newer washer and dryer, plus built-in storage. Two side-by-side spaces in the secure subterranean garage, additional storage, elevator access, and no stairs from parking to the residence provide convenient single-level living. Community amenities include a recreation room with billiards, sauna, kitchen, restrooms, and gathering space. Ideally situated near Averill Park, shopping, dining, freeway access, and beaches, the location also benefits from proximity to the highly anticipated LA Waterfront redevelopment, a transformative 400-acre, $400 million project reimagining the Port of Los Angeles as a premier destination for dining, shopping, entertainment, and waterfront recreation.
